subject: 清初至清中北方马厩（原创扩展；具体细部待考）
prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Image 1 is a precisely measured 9-by-7 footprint isometric stable BLOCKOUT, not the desired art style. TEXTURE AND DETAIL THIS PIXEL-LOCKED BLOCKOUT into a highly realistic Qing northern Chinese stable game sprite. Preserve its ground quadrilateral EXACTLY, preserve camera, do not recenter or enlarge or change width/depth or slopes. Left ground corner(180,590), front(810,905), right(1300,660), rear(670,345). The two visible base edges have slopes EXACT +0.5 and -0.5 and horizontal lengths630 and490, ratio9:7. The desired stable is almost square in plan and has a noticeably deep right side wall. Keep every structural line aligned with the blockout. Replace flat colored shapes with lifelike finely detailed aged gray brick masonry, dark weathered timber, traditional Qing northern gray terracotta roof tiles, simple unglazed clay ridge and very restrained eave curvature. Three open-front stalls face lower-left, with dark timber dividers and separate timber feeding troughs, a little straw within stalls. Front openings fit within the blockout front plane; do not stretch the front face longer. Straight thin stone ground slab, never stepped or kinked. All vertical posts perfectly vertical. This is sober realistic historical map art matching natural fine textured city sprites, not low-poly, vector or cartoon. Soft warm-neutral upper-left light, small contact shadow toward lower-right. Isolated object with TRUE RGBA transparent background. Keep complete object and transparent margins. No numbers, writing, labels, grid, guide lines, people, horses, modern objects, landscape or watermark. Remove all blockout outlines through realistic texturing but keep exact geometry.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚地台、裁切、透视汇聚、黄色帝王琉璃瓦
created_time_basis: copy2保留的源PNG文件mtime；非工具披露的服务端时间

projection_contract.contract_note: 目标契约；实际源图投影误差见geometry_qa，不能据此宣称所有视角合格。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding
processing.anchor_transform_note: 锚点按整数重采样尺寸对应的rounded_effective_scale分别作用于源X/Y；图像仍仅做一次名义等比缩放，差异来自像素取整。

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读同一地台上表面三角点，±3px不确定性；另一代理独立复核。底面中心取(L+R)/2，后角由L+R−F推算；未以变形纠偏。

notes: 第2次运行返修，2候选选2；体块仅为image_gen生成参考，成品仅裁切、等比LANCZOS缩放、透明留白。逐张view_image并浅底alpha合成检查。9×7占地宽深与双轴通过现有阈值。清北匿名功能建筑（原创扩展）；status仍为candidate。
